data.name: MuDustry Tycoon
data.detailed_description:
Build Your Music Career

Start with nothing and work your way to the top of the music industry.

Choose your path as a Rapper, Beatmaker, or DJ, create music, earn money, build your reputation, and prove that you have what it takes to succeed.

Create Music

Write and release your own songs while developing your career. Every release brings new opportunities and helps you grow your fanbase.

Live the Artist Life

Manage your daily routine, balance your time and energy, earn money, and make the right decisions to keep your career moving forward.

Perform Live

Step onto the stage and perform in music clubs to earn cash, gain experience, and increase your popularity.

Build Your Future

Invest in yourself, improve your career, unlock new opportunities, and become one of the biggest names in the music industry.

Features

  • Play as a Rapper, Beatmaker, or DJ

  • Create and release your own music

  • Perform live in clubs

  • Complete daily activities

  • Manage your time, money, and energy

  • Build your fanbase and reputation

  • Grow your music career through your own decisions

About the Developer

MuDustry Tycoon is a solo-developed passion project created by someone who has spent more than 10 years making music and several years working in the music industry.

Author:

One of my biggest dreams has always been to compose an original soundtrack for a video game. Since that opportunity never came, I decided to create the game myself.

Thank you for supporting this project and helping me make that dream come true.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-5200U / AMD Ryzen 3 2200U
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5500 / AMD Radeon Vega 3
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: MacOS 12
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (Early 2015)
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Graphics 6100

  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
